shots.headline: 버거 트럭 운영하기
shots.scene: City map at ~12:10 on a weekday: the first truck serving at the Office Plaza with a long lunch line wrapping the planter, customers with patience bars, HUD (cash, Fame, clock) visible, Boardwalk and Stadium pitches in the background

shots.headline: 주방을 설계하세요
shots.scene: Layout editor of the starter truck (4x3): grill, bench with toaster and sauce rail next to it, window with the fryer beside it, adjacency bonus chips shown, 'Slowest: Window' hint

shots.headline: 하프타임 러시 이기기
shots.sub: 경기 날에는 창구 두 개와 전원 출동
shots.scene: Stadium match day 17:50: halftime stampede banner, crowd packed at a truck with two windows, All hands active, queue counter high, fans in team colours (no real club marks)

shots.headline: 예보에 맞춰 싣기
shots.sub: 적게 싣으면 품절, 많이 싣으면 상함
shots.scene: Morning dispatch: pitch card with tomorrow's forecast (hot, Boardwalk busy), pack list with patties / buns / sides sliders near the suggested amounts, commissary stock bar

shots.headline: 모든 위기 대응
shots.sub: 기름 화재, 비, 프로판, 경쟁 트럭
shots.scene: Boardwalk afternoon: a grease flare-up pulse over the grill with the Extinguish button, a rival truck awning parked nearby, 'Counter-offer' chip visible

shots.headline: 메뉴 키우기
shots.scene: Research sheet open on the Menu branch: Double and Spicy done, Premium fixings in progress with time left, the Kitchen branch tab visible

shots.headline: 선단 만들기
shots.sub: 트럭 두 대, 자리 세 곳, 도시 하나
shots.scene: Wide city map at golden hour: Old Faithful at the Office Plaza and the Box Truck at the Boardwalk, both serving, the stadium bowl and commissary in frame

shots.headline: 별 3개짜리 날 얻기
shots.scene: Day report with 3 stars for service / stock / speed, sales, costs and profit lines, a hint line and the Continue button (no rewarded-ad button in the frame)
